project: Shan Poornam Residence (SP Residence / SP Residency) by ENS

references.feature: Main building - front (road-facing, south per p15 north arrow) facade + side facade (inferred west), three-quarter view, daylight
references.design_details: Stilt + 5 residential floors. White projecting 'picture-frame' bay boxes (5 stacked) with wood-tone soffits; full-height warm copper/teak-tone vertical louvre fins; warm-grey painted walls; sandstone/travertine-look vertical pylon carrying the teal 'SP' sun monogram at the parapet; MS vertical-bar balcony handrails; white UPVC windows; cascading planters at mid-floor ledges; rubble-stone compound wall (left) and timber-look panel compound wall/gates; mature trees.

references.feature: Same three-quarter viewpoint as R01 at dusk (portfolio thumbnail on the developer page)
references.design_details: Only 245x207 px - usable as a lighting/time-of-day reference only, not as a geometry source. Shows warm interior glow, purple-pink dusk sky, road in foreground, white neighbouring bungalow.

references.feature: Building entrance - security cabin at the stilt-level vehicle entry (night)
references.design_details: Glazed cabin with dark fascia carrying illuminated teal 'Shan Poornam Residence by ENS' lettering; timber-slat cladding at base; stilt parking beyond with black/yellow hazard-striped columns and red fire-sprinkler mains on a dark soffit; white bay frames, copper louvres and trailing planters above.

references.feature: Front (south, road-facing) elevation - orthographic-style view at night
references.design_details: Reads as stilt + 5 floors + terrace with rooftop trees and a tall sign mast at the centre-top. Left: white-framed bay stack; two large copper/teak-tone vertical louvre fields; centre: recessed open slot (south end of the central corridor) with planters/trees at every level; right: balcony stacks, white frames, cascading planters. Ground: timber-look compound wall with boom barriers at both ends of the frontage, illuminated security cabin + signage, stilt parking.

references.feature: Entrance frontage - DERIVED CROP of R04 (security cabin, signage, gate, stilt, lower floors)
references.design_details: Right-hand ground frontage of the night elevation: illuminated security cabin with teal signage, timber-look compound wall, boom barrier, stilt parking entry with hazard-striped columns, the lowest residential floors above. Used as the frontage reference for entrance views.

references.feature: Stilt (ground) floor plan - 3D cut-away, keyed 1-9
references.design_details: 1 Private Lobby, 2 Management Office, 3 Co-working/Study, 4 Library, 5 Playground, 6 Garden, 7 Centralised Gasline, 8 Security Cabin, 9 Utilities Area. Two-way central drive aisle, perimeter parking bays (yellow-lined), perimeter landscape strips, two vehicle openings on the south frontage (security cabin at the south-east opening). Car count drawn is illustrative only.

references.feature: Terrace floor plan - 3D cut-away, keyed 10-16
references.design_details: 10 Games Corner, 11 Gym (enclosed, glazed), 12 BBQ Area, 13 Rooftop Lounge (timber deck), 14 Outdoor Lounge, 15 Terrace Garden, 16 Outdoor Yoga Lawn (artificial turf, loungers). Stone-tile feature wall behind BBQ; open light-well over the central corridor; stair/lift heads.

references.feature: Typical floor plan (floors 1-4) - units A-F around a central N-S corridor
references.design_details: West row N->S: C (2BHK), B (2BHK), staircase + lift, A (3BHK). East row N->S: D (3BHK), E (2BHK), F (3BHK). Landscaped courts at both ends of the corridor. Road along the south edge. North arrow points up the page.

references.feature: Apartment hall - living zone in foreground, dining zone + window at far end
references.design_details: Long linear hall (matches the 28'4" x 11' halls of Types A/D/F). Left wall: large-format travertine-look vertical panels with dark-walnut framed openings; right: TV wall in vertical dark-walnut fluting with wall-hung TV, black-metal floor-to-ceiling rod shelving with backlit shelves and brass decor, floating walnut console with smoked fluted-glass shutters. White ceiling, recessed downlights, two white 3-blade ceiling fans, walnut-clad bulkhead dividing living/dining, split AC over the window. Light-grey sofa with grey/brown cushions, grey tub armchair, jute flat-weave rug, white hydrangea centrepiece. Light beige polished large-format floor tiles. White sheers + taupe drapes. Dark-walnut doors and frames.

references.feature: Dining zone - DERIVED CROP of R14 (no standalone dining render exists in the brochure)
references.design_details: Oval/round glass-top dining table with taupe upholstered shell chairs on dark legs and a dried-flower centrepiece, beneath the walnut bulkhead; full-height window with white sheers and taupe drapes opening to a balcony with white vertical balusters; split AC and white ceiling fan above. Low resolution (230 px) - detail reference only. Floor plans show 6-seat rectangular tables (A/B/C/D/F) and a 4-seat round table (E).

references.feature: Bedroom - the only bedroom render in the brochure (treated as master bedroom; brochure does not label it)
references.design_details: Bed wall wraps the corner: dark-walnut panelling to dado height, above it four walnut-framed panels of an illustrated tropical-leaf mural (beige/ochre/brown, one leopard-spotted leaf) with concealed cove light; cream upholstered headboard, taupe bedding, rust cushions; walnut bedside units with brass-base lamps (white shades); dark wide-plank walnut-look floor; grey/ivory textured rug; tan leather lounge chair with throw by the window; walnut box niches on the left wall; white sheers + taupe drapes; white 3-blade ceiling fan; recessed downlights.

references.feature: Balcony / sit-out - extracted original is wider than the crop printed on page 24
references.design_details: Honey-toned wood-look floor tiles; travertine-look wall cladding both sides; sculptural face-mask wall art; wall-mounted wood-tone planter boxes with trailing greens; two beige upholstered lounge chairs on slim brass frames with mustard cushions; round fluted pedestal side table; white MS vertical-baluster handrail with flat top rail; charcoal soffit; view to a neighbouring building and trees.

references.feature: Private lobby (stilt level, key 1)
references.design_details: Exposed soffit with red sprinkler mains and services; travertine-look wall panels; lift door in grey/SS; timber restroom door; mustard and ivory bucket chairs on wire legs, walnut coffee table, walnut console with plants; woven rattan pendant; horizontal-stripe frosted glass partition; walnut floor zone meeting polished white large-format tiles.

references.feature: Lobby lounge / library (stilt level) - UNCAPTIONED in the brochure; identified by shared materials with R18
references.design_details: Exposed grey soffit with cassette AC; charcoal leather sofas and armchair; walnut floor with LED edge stepping down to a polished white tile walkway; backlit walnut + black-metal bookshelf (likely the Library, key 4); rattan-detailed side cabinets; woven pendant; striped frosted glass; tall travertine-look panels with shadow gaps.

references.feature: Management office (stilt level, key 2)
references.design_details: Light-grey fluted wall panel with framed botanical sketch; white desk with all-in-one computer; two black mesh task chairs; full-height walnut bookshelf with backlit shelves; striped frosted glass partition; timber door with long brass pull; white large-format floor tiles.

references.feature: Co-working / study room (stilt level, key 3)
references.design_details: Three workstations on a white worktop, light-oak overhead cabinets and pedestal drawers, black mesh chairs, monitors, travertine-look wall tiles, striped frosted glazing, window at left.

references.feature: Gym - cardio zone (terrace, key 11)
references.design_details: Light wood-look floor; grey walls; crossing linear LED strips + recessed spots on the ceiling; ellipticals and treadmills along a glazed wall with horizontal blinds and planting outside; glass door to the terrace.

references.feature: Gym - strength zone (terrace, key 11)
references.design_details: Same shell as R22; large bodybuilder wall mural; multi-station machine, benches with orange upholstery, dumbbell rack, yellow/grey Swiss balls.

references.feature: Rooftop lounge + BBQ + games corner (terrace, keys 10/12/13)
references.design_details: Covered timber deck under a dark soffit with downlights; slate/sandstone tile feature wall with wall clock; BBQ counter with tan leather bar stools; carved walnut cabinet; two dining tables with ivory shell chairs and flowers; foosball table; glazed gym beyond; stone wall with ENS logo; tropical planters; pallet-style timber benches.

references.feature: Typical-floor common corridor (matches central corridor of the typical plan)
references.design_details: Grey speckled granite floor with two black-granite inlay bands; black skirting; cream walls; dark-walnut doors/frames with brass number plates; white wall-mounted cabinets beside doors; raised false-ceiling tray with perimeter cove light, brass ring pendants and downlights; window to greenery at the far end.

references.feature: Amenities icon sheet - 21 amenities in 4 groups
references.design_details: Private comfort/safety & security (5), Lifestyle (4), Outdoor living (6), Infrastructure (6).

references.feature: Strategically located - distance/time table
references.design_details: Education, healthcare, shopping, hotels, leisure, landmarks, connectivity with km + minutes.

references.feature: Location map - 1-5 km rings around the site
references.design_details: Schools, colleges, hospitals, landmarks, bus stand, railway station, airport (diagrammatic map).

references.feature: Project facts page - 26 homes, unit mix, 85% carpet efficiency, strategic location
references.design_details: 4 BHK x1, 3 BHK x13, 2 BHK x12; 3 BHK from 1472 sq.ft carpet.

references.feature: Cover - Shan Poornam Residence by ENS wordmark
references.design_details: Teal sun/moon wordmark on deep navy with vertical-bar motif. Developer trademark - reference only.

references.feature: Foundational vision - SP sun monogram, meaning of Shan (five elements) and Poornam (completeness)
references.design_details: Brand story source text. Developer trademark - reference only.

missing_categories.bedrooms: Only ONE bedroom render exists (filed under ../master-bedroom/). No secondary/kids bedroom design is shown. Secondary bedrooms are documented only by plan dimensions and the floor spec (wooden glazed vitrified tiles 48" x 8').
